newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak March real retail sales +7.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Slovak March real retail sales +7.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Slovak real retail sales in March 1997 rose 7.1 percent, year-on-year, compared to an annual increase of 5.4 percent in February, the Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Tuesday.
In March 1996, retail sales rose a real 14.7 percent year-on-year.
SUSR said retail sales totalled 74.5 billion crowns in the first quarter of the year, a 7.1 percent increase over the same period in 1996.
Sales for January-February 1997 rose 6.9 percent, year-on-year, and totalled 48.6 billion crowns.
The statement did not disclose any further details.
